INSERT INTO forge_job_dedup (queue, dedup_id, job_id, expires_at)
                   VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now() + make_interval(secs => $4))
                   ON CONFLICT (queue, dedup_id) DO UPDATE
                     SET job_id = EXCLUDED.job_id, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
                     WHERE forge_job_dedup.expires_at <= now()
                   RETURNING job_id
